title: Count of Smaller Numbers After Self

monster.name: Fenwick Specter
monster.title: Inversion Counter of the Trailing Veil
monster.defeatQuote: For each nums[i], count of smaller elements to its right tallied!

description: Given an integer array `nums`, return an integer array `counts` where `counts[i]` is the number of smaller elements to the right of `nums[i]`.
solutionCode:
def countSmaller(nums: list[int]) -> list[int]:
    import bisect
    sorted_list = []
    ans = []
    for x in reversed(nums):
        idx = bisect.bisect_left(sorted_list, x)
        ans.append(idx)
        sorted_list.insert(idx, x)
    return ans[::-1]
hints: Iterate from right to left, using binary search (bisect_left) to find position in sorted seen numbers.

def countSmaller(nums: list[int]) -> list[int]:
    import bisect
    sorted_list = []
    ans = []
    for x in reversed(nums):
